events.decision: Read-only security and architecture review; no application edits or protected path access.

risks: Bound pending lifecycle state, not just identity rows
Group credential identity across transport without duplicate connected agent claims
Attach lifecycle observation before await; cover finish, close, abort, error, timeout
Keep tenant authorization authoritative and invalidate stale browser contexts

resolved_findings.finding: Authentication failures on new dashboard routes escaped generic catch and exposed internal errors via server wrapper.
Authenticated pending tenant resolution was not observed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Developer moved observer lifecycle before getMemoryService in MCP and ordinary HTTP.

remaining_findings.finding: Automatic15s poll supersedes still-pending activity requests, starving results when latency exceeds poll interval.
Filter edits followed by Next reuse old offset; empty later pages display reversed numeric ranges.

resolved_findings: Dashboard authentication exceptions now generic503 and no-store; regression verified.
MCP and fallback HTTP lifecycle starts before tenant factory awaits.
Observer caps both identity entries and pending requests; lifecycle releases finish/close/abort/error and deadline.
Edited history filters reset pagination; empty later pages offer Previous without reversed numeric range.
Automatic polls skip in-flight request; timeout/manual replacement/logout abort with response generation guards.

validation_reported_by_parent.skips: Opt-in Postgres integration tests; no database credentials accessed.
validation_reported_by_parent.browser: Real local fixture verified history/filter/pages, hostile text rendering, error/logout and tenant context switch.

review_limitations: Root checks/evals traversing protected packages/core or harness paths not run without authorization.
No production database, live credentials, provider requests, or external deployment reviewed.
documented_product_limits: History presents current saved records, not revision or deletion audit.
Presence is process-local bounded observed request evidence, with max request lease, recent TTL and no replica aggregation.
Identity rows group verified credentials by transport; shared credentials do not uniquely identify runtime agents.
Workspace membership is unknown; tenant isolation remains authoritative.
